about.title: Senior Backend Engineer
about.summary: I build scalable backend systems with Python, AWS, and PostgreSQL, and I also work on AI/LLM integrations with LangSmith and modern orchestration tooling.
bio: I’m a backend-focused software engineer with 7+ years of experience building scalable services, event-driven systems, and cloud-based applications.

My core stack includes Python, FastAPI, Django, Flask, AWS, and PostgreSQL. I’ve worked on production systems in fintech and education, focusing on performance, reliability, testing, and maintainable architecture.
More recently, I’ve also been working on AI/LLM integrations, including orchestration, evaluations, and production workflows with LangGraph, LangSmith, and modern LLM tooling.

bullets: Built scalable FastAPI services and AWS serverless components for production systems.
Increased automated test coverage by 35% through integration and unit testing.
Implemented LangGraph and LangSmith workflows for AI/LLM orchestration, tracing, and evaluations.
Developed Django microservices using hexagonal architecture.
Improved PostgreSQL performance by ~25% through query and indexing optimization.
Collaborated with QA, product, and frontend teams in Scrum delivery.
Built Django/DRF payment services handling 50k+ transactions per month.
Developed payment gateway plugins for WooCommerce, PrestaShop, and Magento.
Improved code quality through PEP8 standards and automated testing.
Delivered backend solutions with Flask RESTful, MongoDB/MySQL, and PHP.
Administered Linux servers and automated operational tasks.
Reduced manual workload by ~40% through scripting and automation.
